version: v3 (three levels: multiscalar parent, multi-categorical per bundle, scalar per repo)

source.request: 2026-10-01: the round-3 set created 2026-09-22 (originality-r3) is missing its middle level. Build a new, complete set: parent 'evaluated repository counts' (multiscalar, Bundle A/B/C) -> one conditional multi-categorical market per bundle ('which repositories were evaluated?') -> one originality scalar per repo, conditional on that repo's outcome. Keep the incorrect set and its 1k liquidity so its users can exit; flag it as incorrect in the UI.
source.priceSourceNote: Same prices as originality-r3: the round-2 pools' last prices, copied unchanged from campaigns/originality-r3/originality-r3-seed.json by build-originality-r3-v3-seed.js.

supersedes.originality-r3: Two levels only: 98 score markets conditional directly on the bundle tokens of parent 0x52f80FC4fa783AB5850d1658589284c47a21B3b7. Left live with its 1,000 sUSDS so the 4 wallets that deposited 3,339.67 sUSDS can sell back and merge out. Its files are untouched.

stages.name: phase0-intake
stages.notes: Grill answered 2026-10-01. Seed copied from originality-r3 by the builder script: same repos, bundles and prices; middle level and _R3C symbols added.

stages.name: phase0-rehearsal
stages.notes: Hardhat fork of Optimism, live run against the fork. Found that MarketView.getMarket reverts for the middle markets; scripts switched to a direct reader. Creation rehearsed in full (102 markets). Seeding rehearsed through all splits and 28 pools, then stopped before the real run.

stages.name: gate
stages.notes: Approved. Pre-live dry run re-diffed against the approved log: immutable block identical, 0 Reality collisions.

stages.name: create-markets
stages.notes: 1 parent, 3 middle (13.3-13.5M gas each, about 80% of the 2^24 cap), 98 score markets. No retries, no failures. check --markets-only: VERIFY OK.

stages.name: seed-pools
stages.notes: 1 parent split (1000 sUSDS), 3 middle splits (about 5.5M gas each), 98 score splits, 196 pools. Run 1 died at pool 71 on an RPC timeout inside ethers receipt polling (an approve was in flight, no mint); run 2 resumed and finished. Wallet sUSDS 59251.373 -> 58251.373.

stages.name: phase1-verify
stages.notes: Full verify OK from live chain: 102 markets, 196/196 pools within 0.001 of seed, 1000 parent Invalid and 1000 Invalid of each middle market held, no idle bundle or repo tokens. Failure tests: 6 corrupted structure fields -> all caught (on the fork); corrupted price -> both legs caught (mainnet).

stages.name: phase2-ui
stages.notes: Round 3 tab and leaderboard entry point at this set; the first set is its own withdraw-only tab with a notice on both. Mint splits on each middle market in its own transaction; sell-all merges the middle markets before the parent. tsc -b, build and lint pass; Chromium at 1440px and 400px: 98 rows, 0 console errors; all 196 UI prices equal chain to 1e-16. NOT run with a wallet: trade and sell-all through the middle level. Redeem for three levels is not built.

checks: fork rehearsal of the live create run: found the MarketView revert before anything was sent
create dry run re-diffed vs gate: identical
markets-only verify OK; 6 corrupted seed fields caught
liquidity dry run vs preview: within 0.04 repo token of 1000 per repo
full verify OK: 196/196 pools on seed
corrupted price caught on both legs
evidenceLog.learning: A conditional market with more outcome slots than its parent has outcomes cannot be read through MarketView.getMarket (it lists the parent outcomes using the child condition). The write path is unaffected. A split on a 34-slot market costs about 5.5M gas, so splits on two levels must not share a transaction.
